stories.title: Apple Updates Everything, (Mon, Sep 14th)
stories.description: Today, Apple released its annual update across all its operating systems. With that, Apple not only released new features but also patched 261 different vulnerabilities. This is the most vulnerabilities Apple has ever patched, but the increase is not as…

stories.title: New DDRop Attack Breaks Intel TDX and AMD SEV-SNP Confidential Computing
stories.description: DDRop uses server control and a DDR5 interposer to replay stale encrypted data in Intel TDX, Scalable SGX, and AMD SEV-SNP.

stories.title: 3BB Attacker Used MeshCentral Backdoor for Root Access, Targeted Subscriber Credentials
stories.description: Researchers found an attacker with root access inside 3BB using MeshCentral for persistence and targeting subscriber RADIUS databases.

stories.title: Telegram Desktop Flaw Lets Hidden JavaScript Exfiltrate Messages From HTML Exports
stories.description: Telegram Desktop fixed a flaw that let bot messages embed JavaScript in HTML exports to read or alter messages; old exports remain affected.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit FortiGate SSL-VPN Vulnerability to Attack Broadband Provider
stories.description: Researchers have uncovered an exposed attacker-controlled staging server containing evidence of a wide-ranging intrusion targeting 3BB, the consumer brand operated by Thailand’s Triple T Broadband.

stories.title: Hackers Mass-Scan Exposed Vite Servers to Steal AWS and Azure Cloud Credentials
stories.description: Hackers are conducting a large-scale automated scanning campaign against internet-exposed Vite development servers, attempting to steal AWS credentials, Azure access tokens, environment variables, and Infrastructure-as-Code secrets.

stories.title: Red Heron Exploits Gitea RCE to Compromise 13 Organizations Across Six Countries
stories.description: Red Heron exploited Gitea CVE-2026-60004 to steal repositories, collect credentials, persist, and move laterally across victim networks

stories.title: UK Government Begins Moving 23 Million Users Away From Passwords
stories.description: The UK government has begun rolling out passkeys across GOV.UK One Login, offering more than 23 million users a passwordless way to access public services.

stories.title: Nintendo Switch Vulnerability Allows Attackers to Run Unauthorized Code on Your Console
stories.description: Nintendo has patched a high-severity vulnerability in the original Nintendo Switch that could let a nearby attacker execute unauthorized code and access information stored on the console.

stories.title: Beijing Hits Back at Anthropic CEO’s Call to Curb China’s AI Development
stories.description: China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs responded to a question about Amodei’s essay by saying that all parties should work together on AI.

stories.title: New Warnings About the Risks of AI to Humanity Revive a Long-Running Debate
stories.description: Concerns over the potential risks of the technology are rising as new AI models become more powerful, heightening both the potential for misuse by people with criminal aims.

stories.title: Personal, Financial Info Exposed in Revolut Data Breach
stories.description: The company unintentionally disclosed users’ information to a third party impersonating a government agency.

stories.title: The Race to Control AI and Protect What Makes Us Human
stories.description: As researchers warn that misaligned AI could threaten human survival, even beneficial systems may erode the critical thinking that defines our humanity.
